title: Privacy gets its own card with a paragraph, shows a database column name, and switches with one click
what_happens: A whole card exists to hold a paragraph explaining the setting. On a Connect session the text ends with '(participants.connect_consent_at)', a raw database column. 'Make anonymous' / 'Make it a Connect session' change what participants are told, but run on one click with no confirm (privacy-toggle.tsx). The 'Send on WhatsApp' card also opens with an explanation line.
who_hurts: Dane or another organizer reading the page: the paragraph and column name are noise; a mis-click changes what new participants are asked, with no chance to back out.
suggested_fix: Make privacy a labelled row (e.g. 'Privacy: Connect · 0 opted in') with the explanation behind an 'i' tooltip and in a confirm dialog on switch (reuse the ArchiveToggle Dialog pattern). Drop the column name. Move the WhatsApp explanation into an 'i' tooltip too.
rule: Dane's UI rule: 'Keep explanation off the top level of the page ... Never give a control its own section or card just to hold a paragraph about it.'
